subject: Proposal: staggered team enablement + burst capacity amendment
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: staggered team enablement + burst capacity amendment

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our discussion, Orchid is planning to expand use of the Redwood platform to three additional internal squads (Provider Sync, CareOps, and Billing ML). To keep the production rollout low-risk, you asked for a staggered issuance of API credentials and a short-term burst capacity increase while the new teams ramp.

High-level proposal (attached: Orchid-Amendment-v1.pdf, pricing-summary-ORCH-2026.xlsx):
- Add 3 project keys (one per team) under the existing enterprise account.
- Temporary burst capacity: +25% dedicated throughput for 90 days starting on the first key activation.
- Billing: apply a one-time addendum to the existing reserved capacity contract for the incremental capacity. Token pricing for the burst period: $16.50 per 1M generation tokens (discounted from the standard $20).
- Term: 12-month addendum to align with your existing commitment window; amendment auto-terminates the burst after 90 days unless converted to reserved capacity.

Suggested rollout timeline:
1) Week 1: Provider Sync key issued — smoke tests and SSO config.
2) Week 2-3: CareOps onboarding; run evals and traffic shaping.
3) Week 4: Billing ML receives key; start canary traffic.

Next steps I recommend from our side: we can prepare a DocuSign amendment for signature and queue the key provisioning once we have a signed PO or DocuSign completion. I've attached the addendum draft for your review.

Would you like us to stagger activation into production by team (as above) or flip the order? Also, confirm whether Procurement wants a consolidated invoice or per-team billing.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

---
Attachment stubs: Orchid-Amendment-v1.pdf (12 pages), pricing-summary-ORCH-2026.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchidhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Elliott <claire.elliott@orchidhealth.com>, platform@orchidhealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: staggered team enablement + burst capacity amendment

Jonas — thanks for the clear plan. This is close to what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications before I loop in procurement:

- Pricing: can you confirm the non-burst incremental token price if any of the teams convert to steady-state reserved capacity after 90 days?
- Security: our platform team asked whether each project key can be scoped to a specific VPC and whether SSO enforcement is available per key.
- Procurement: please include a DocuSign-ready amendment and a separate statement of work (if we need to capture onboarding hours).

Claire — I’m copying you to start the PO process. We’ll want net45 terms by default but can be flexible with SaaS vendors if there’s good cadence on invoicing.

Thanks,
Samir
VP Product — Orchid Health
samir.patel@orchidhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchidhealth.com>, Claire Elliott <claire.elliott@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: staggered team enablement + burst capacity amendment

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 10:03 AM Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchidhealth.com> wrote:
> Jonas — thanks for the clear plan. This is close to what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications before I loop in procurement:
>
> - Pricing: can you confirm the non-burst incremental token price if any of the teams convert to steady-state reserved capacity after 90 days?
> - Security: our platform team asked whether each project key can be scoped to a specific VPC and whether SSO enforcement is available per key.
> - Procurement: please include a DocuSign-ready amendment and a separate statement of work (if we need to capture onboarding hours).

Samir / Claire —

Thanks for the questions. Quick answers:
- Conversion pricing: if a team converts into a reserved seat/pool within 90 days, we will credit the burst volume against the first month of the reserved commit. Reserved pricing proposals vary by commit; ballpark for a 12-month incremental commit of equivalent throughput is $13.00 per 1M generation tokens. We can add a credit clause to the amendment.
- Key scoping: yes — we can issue project keys that are scoped by VPC + allowed origin ranges. SSO enforcement (SAML) can be applied at the team key level; we will require an initial SSO provisioning window before keys go live.
- DocuSign & SOW: attaching the amendment draft (Orchid-Amendment-v1.pdf) and the pricing workbook. I'll prepare a short SOW for onboarding hours (estimate: 12-20 engineer-hours across three teams).

Procurement note: we typically accept Net30 by standard; net45 is doable but we'd prefer Net30 or a partial upfront invoice for setup. If Net45 is a hard constraint for Orchid, we can route to Finance for approval and will flag on the DocuSign.

Next steps: Jonas will update the amendment with the credit clause and create a DocuSign envelope. Once we have a signed DocuSign or PO, keys are scheduled for provisioning per the timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

---

Subject: Re: Proposal: staggered team enablement + burst capacity amendment

Marissa / Jonas —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few procurement items and redlines from our legal/finance review:
- Payment terms: Orchid prefers EOM +45 (Net45) rather than Net30. Please confirm acceptance or indicate if Finance needs to sign off.
- Invoicing: single consolidated monthly invoice for the amendment is preferred.
- Audit evidence: legal requests SOC 2 Type II report and access to audit/logging for a 30-day window during the onboarding burst for compliance testing.
- Clause: please include a short SLA addendum that captures dedicated burst availability (we propose 99.5% availability for the burst window).

I’ve looped in our platform alias for SOC review; they may ask for more details on VPC scoping.

If you can update the DocuSign with our preferred billing terms and attach your SOC 2 report, we’ll route for signature.

Regards,
Claire Elliott
Senior Procurement Manager — Orchid Health
claire.elliott@orchidhealth.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Elliott <claire.elliott@orchidhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchidhealth.com>

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: staggered team enablement + burst capacity amendment

Claire / Samir —

Appreciate the clear redlines. Short responses and an execution plan: 
1) Payment terms: we can accept EOM+45 for this amendment; Finance has pre-approved for Orchid based on account history. We will reflect EOM+45 in the DocuSign.
2) Invoicing: we will issue a single consolidated monthly invoice for the addendum.
3) SOC2 & logs: attached to this message is a link to our SOC 2 Type II summary and an object storage access window for audit logs during the 90-day burst. Public SOC2 summary: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2-summary.pdf (internal access link will be added to the DocuSign envelope).
4) SLA: we will add a burst-specific 99.5% availability clause to the amendment.

Key provisioning plan (post-signature):
- Day 0: DocuSign completes / PO submitted.
- Day 1: Issue Provider Sync key and start SSO configuration window (48-72 hours for SSO handoff).
- Day 8: Issue CareOps key after successful smoke tests.
- Day 22: Issue Billing ML key and enable canary routing.

If Orchid prefers a different ordering (e.g., prioritize Billing ML first), we can flip the schedule. Please confirm the order and we will prepare the DocuSign with your billing and SLA redlines.

DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/en/signature/placeholder/ORCH-AMEND-0042
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ORCH-2026-EXP-0042

Thanks — I’ll queue the updated amendment and SOW once I have confirmation on team order.

Regards,
